correctness.rationale: LSW Theorem 1.4 gives torsion-free third-homology rank N=binomial(r-1,2)binomial(s-1,2). The explicit 16-term 3x3 octahedral cycle has zero boundary. The six-term cochain pairs to 1 and has zero coboundary on all 45 relevant faces, so the seed is a primitive generator. Exact signed Lefschetz computations yield row and column sign actions. Each vertex-amalgamation projection preserves the no-three-matching property, and the induced homology map on embedded seed cycles is either degree 0 or a product of permutation signs. N coordinate projections give a splitting onto Z^N and hence an isomorphism by rank and freeness. Coordinate-wise comparison with contraction of exterior cubes determines the integral representation, kernel and alternating relations; finite checks do not substitute for the all-rank proof.

value.rationale: The k=3 external tensor is explicitly motivated by Conjecture 1.15 in the original source. Unlike a computed numerical rank or routine Specht character, the theorem specifies the entire integral S_r times S_s lattice, primitive geometric 3-sphere generators, a uniform integral basis and all integer relations for arbitrary r,s.
